# toast-provider

Exports: `useToast`, `ToastProvider`

Source: `index.tsx` in this folder. Import: `import { ToastProvider } from "@bytesphere/ui"`

## Toast (ToastProvider, useToast)

Bottom-right, max 3, errors persist with an action, 5s for the rest.

Use when: toast notification; undo snackbar; success message after save.
- **Accessibility:** Live region; never for decisions or validation.
- **Live example:** `#/components` in the showcase

```tsx
const toast = useToast();
toast({ tone: "success", title: "Saved", action: { label: "Undo", onClick } });
```
